descriptions.cc42b_remove_slot_801e183c: For a nonnull indexed slot, releases and clears it, shifts subsequent held interfaces left by acquire-before-release assignment with live slot reloads, clears the final extent slot, and decrements the active count. Preserves unsigned extent-minus-one behavior and callback order. Observed 32-slot partial C++ owner and refcount-interface views; callback return types/full original declarations and full owner size unknown. No data ownership.
